title: Builder inbox and heartbeat activation
summary: The loopback-only command center now holds eight subscription-backed Claude workers, with every unstarted package behind a human-only gate.
evidence: Retrieval and Access orientation runs completed successfully under separate workspace confinement.
Six additional workers match the six independent G2 packages and no extra build workers were provisioned.
Every worker has a separate no-remote worktree, sanitized database copy, bounded instructions, and a 40-turn task budget.
The new kickoff issues remain in backlog and all eight workers are idle.
No Anthropic API key or metered Anthropic API billing is used.
Production, DNS, deployment, and GitHub push authority remain with Iron Man only.
limitations: Build gates remain closed until the independent Claude G1 review publishes per-builder GO instructions. Cole Inbox wiring follows a clean first build cycle.
